name: @calyx/client-sdk-php
description: PHP client for the Calyx backend and core APIs, with webhook checks.

scripts.test: docker/run.sh test-client && docker/run.sh test-core && cd fakecore && GOPRIVATE='github.com/csmarckitus/*' go test -race ./...
scripts.lint: docker/run.sh lint-client && docker/run.sh lint-core && cd fakecore && GOPRIVATE='github.com/csmarckitus/*' go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.15.0 run --config ../../../../.golangci.yml ./...
scripts.generate: cd ../tools && go run ./cmd/phpgen && cd ../php && docker/run.sh protoc
scripts.generate:check: cd ../tools && go run ./cmd/phpgen -check && cd ../php && docker/run.sh protoc-check
